moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-loading-orbit-trail, written here): Thin ring r42 (1.5 px). Six dots on it: the head and 5 followers 20° behind each other, opacity 1 / .72 / .5 / .34 / .2 / .12, radius 6.5 / 5.6 / 4.9 / 4.3 / 3.7 / 3.2 px. The group rotates clockwise from 12 o'clock, linear, 1.4 s per turn. Params: period (1.4 s / vòng) · dots (6, cách 20°) · radius (42 px) · fade (1 → 0.12).
